reviews.shade: Torriden Balanceful Cica Toner Pad 60 Pads Special Set (+10 Pads)
reviews.text:
メイク前の角栓除去に使えるトナーパッドを探していてこれにたどり着きました。
これをやるとやらないではメイク乗りが違うし程よく保湿もされるので良いです。
洗顔代わりにも使えます。
肌に優しく鎮静効果のあるCICA成分が配合されてるので赤みなどにも効く気がします。
reviews.zh: 一直想搵一塊可以用喺化妝前清除黑頭粉刺嘅化妝水pad，最後揀到呢隻。有用同冇用真係差好遠，妝容貼服度完全唔同，而且有適度嘅保濕效果，好正。仲可以當洗面用。加入咗對肌膚溫和、有鎮靜效果嘅CICA成分，感覺對泛紅都有效用。

reviews.shade: Torriden Balanceful Cica Toner Pad 60 Pads Special Set (+10 Pads)
reviews.text: Got this for some sort of exfoliating factor in my skincare, i was nervous to try a stronger bha or aha so I settled with this, it's been treating me really great it absorbs fast, no irritation or dehydration, it's been pretty helpful for what my deep clean days.
reviews.zh: 買呢個係為咗喺護膚程序入面加少少去角質效果，我唔敢試太強嘅BHA或者AHA，所以揀咗呢隻。用咗覺得好好，吸收得快，冇刺激感都冇抽乾水，反而喺我深層清潔嘅日子幫咗我唔少。

reviews.shade: Torriden Balanceful Cica Toner Pad 60 Pads Special Set (+10 Pads)
reviews.text: I really like this product. It worked very well for my sensitive skin and didn’t cause any irritation or breakouts. My skin felt smooth and comfortable after using it, which is rare for me. I’ve tried many similar products, but this one stands out for being gentle and effective at the same time. I will definitely be purchasing it again and would recommend it to anyone with sensitive skin. I love it!
reviews.zh: 我好鍾意呢個產品。對我嘅敏感肌嚟講效果好好，冇引起任何刺激或者爆瘡。用完之後皮膚感覺滑溜又舒服，對我嚟講好難得。我試過好多類似嘅產品，但呢隻最突出係溫和同有效兼備。一定會回購，會推薦畀任何敏感肌嘅人。我好鍾意！

reviews.shade: Torriden Balanceful Cica Toner Pad 60 Pads Special Set (+10 Pads)
reviews.text: Every toner I’ve ever tried dried my skin out really bad. These toner pads are the best. I’ve been using these and Korean face wash and havnt had a bad break out since. I get one or two pimples here and there. But my skin hasn’t been irritated or dry or oily since I started using these daily in the mornings. They work very well as makeup wipes. The little tongs help too because you don’t have to reach in with your hands.
reviews.zh: 我試過嘅每支化妝水都會令我皮膚乾到爆。呢款toner pad係最勁嘅。我一路用緊呢款加韓國洗面乳，自此就冇再大爆瘡。有時會生一兩粒痘痘。但自從我每日朝早用佢之後，皮膚就冇再受刺激、又唔乾又唔油。當化妝濕紙巾用都好正。細鉗都好幫到手，因為唔使直接用手伸入去。

reviews.shade: Torriden Balanceful Cica Toner Pad 60 Pads Special Set (+10 Pads)
reviews.text: Great texture, absorbs quickly, and works well in a layered routine. Keeps skin hydrated and balanced without irritation. A reliable everyday product. Would recommend.
reviews.zh: 質地好，吸收得快，喺疊加嘅護膚程序入面表現好好。保持皮膚保濕同平衡，冇刺激。係一款可靠嘅日常產品。會推薦。

reviews.shade: Torriden Balanceful Cica Toner Pad 60 Pads Special Set (+10 Pads)
reviews.text: I bought this together with the blue packaging one. However, I feel a slight stinging sensation when I use it on dry skin. People with sensitive skin should be careful when using it.
reviews.zh: 我同藍色包裝嗰款一齊買。但係搽喺乾嘅皮膚上面會有少少刺痛感。敏感肌嘅人用嘅時候要小心。

reviews.shade: Torriden Balanceful Cica Toner Pad 60 Pads Special Set (+10 Pads)
reviews.text: 1st time try tonerpad and THIS IS THE BEST ONE FOR OILY SKIN!!! It helps my acnes and red aera also so soothe my skin so well. I LOVE IT. DEF REPURCHASE
reviews.zh: 第一次用toner pad，呢隻絕對係油性肌嘅恩物！！！幫到我啲暗瘡同泛紅，仲好舒緩皮膚。我勁鍾意。一定回購

reviews.shade: Torriden Balanceful Cica Toner Pad 60 Pads Special Set (+10 Pads)
reviews.text: I love this toning pad quite a lot. I feel like it does smooth out my skin. it has 60 sheets . I have purchased this quite recently and have only started using it so my opinion is only from what I have been using for a couple of days though I do believe it could’ve been better, but I still believe it did a good amount in such a short amount of time, I am still looking for a toner or any facial products that can work with my textured skin, as well as my pores and blackheads. I also have combination skin.
reviews.zh: 我好鍾意呢塊toning pad。我覺得佢有平滑到我嘅皮膚。一盒有60片。我啱啱先買，啱啱開始用，所以都只係用咗幾日嘅感想，雖然我覺得可以再好啲，但我仍然覺得佢喺咁短時間已經做到唔少嘢。我仲喺搵緊適合我膚質（膚質有顆粒加埋毛孔同黑頭問題）嘅化妝水或者其他護膚品。我都有混合性肌膚。
